purpose: E11 generalization probes: 3 families x 5 tasks (A long-horizon chains, B figure-entry perturbation degraded to caption-text grounding, C multi-task integration). Restores discriminative power that dev(8)/ood(4) lack (E4: one dev-task flip = 12.5pp). Evaluation-only: never trainable, frozen protocol untouched.

policy.selection_use: Diagnostic only. Probes must never enter any training pool (v6/v7/v3 untouched) and must not be used for model selection.

budget.note: Uniform per-family budget so long-chain failures are not confounded with FORCE_STOP budget starvation.

judging.strict: All 15 tasks reuse the existing strict seven-condition gate (metrics.is_strict_success): FINISH + exact tool sequence + arg_score==1 + ref_score==1 + 0 parse failures + 0 tool failures + terminal semantics.
judging.integration_complete: C family additionally carries expected_integration_paper_ids on each task dict; evaluate_integration() in benchmark/tasks_probe.py checks the final FINISH thought cites every target id (version-suffix-insensitive). Report-side (+2 keys) extension is deliberately deferred; this split adds no scoring code.
judging.b5_refusal: probe_b5_non_paper_image_refusal reuses the existing blocked terminal semantics (expected_terminal_mode=blocked, expected_terminal_reason=unsupported_capability).

known_degradations: Family B inputs are caption-text descriptions pregenerated from snapshot metadata: the benchmark agent input channel is text-only (BaseAgent.run(task: str)), BenchmarkRunner never enables vision_policy, and the [figure:...] JPG assets live outside this worktree.

probe_a3_bad_id_recovery carries the deterministic snapshot rejection as user-reported narrative instead of a gold-trajectory step: the oracle replay fails fast on error steps and strict requires zero tool failures, so a gold chain containing a necessarily-failing call could never pass.
No probe uses get_translated_content: the frozen snapshot records zero pages for it.

probe_c2_time_window_contrast: replay pools are window-independent, so the two-window difference is deterministically empty; judged on the two windowed search calls plus integration over the intersection.
